name: Gardienne des réserves
description: Tall adult female with long legs, pale green-grey finely spotted skin, high broad domed crest, four fine angular mandibles, long dark dreadlocks tied behind. Layered sand cloth ankle-length split outer garment over utilitarian knee trousers, faded turquoise stitch trims in keeping with the tribe, bronze arm plates. One arm holds a flat elongated bronze cistern survey tablet with blue-glass bubble-level tube inset; other hand holds a short bent valve key. Upright supervisory pose.
